newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sydkraft says has 13.3 pct Germany's HEW.
newsitem.headline: Sydkraft says has 13.3 pct Germany's HEW.

text.p: Swedish power company Sydkraft AB said on Tuesday it finalised a purchase of a 12.5 percent stake of shares in Hamburgische Elektricitats-Werke (HEW) and bought additional shares in the company.
Sydkraft said in a statement its stake in HEW now totalled 13.3 percent of the shares.
Sydkraft said it financed the purchase through a reduction of its stake in VEBA to 1.7 percent from 3.2 percent.

At the beginning of the year Sydkraft's stake in VEBA was worth six billion crowns. The stake had appreciated in value since 1992 and part of this capital gain financed the purchase of HEW shares, Sydkraft said.
Sydkraft said it bought the stake in HEW from the City of Hamburg.
